label_remap.note: The bundled dataset encodes malignant as 0. This experiment remaps malignant to the positive class 1 and benign to 0 before splitting.

provenance.coursework: This experiment reimplements the CSC781 Module 6 Assignment 6 protocol. It corrects normalization and selection of the learning rate and threshold. It reuses no historical outputs or report scores.

preprocessing.scaler: z-score using the population mean and standard deviation
preprocessing.fit_on: The scaler fits training data only. It uses the stored statistics to transform development and test data.
preprocessing.constant_features: A zero-variance training column keeps scale 1.0, so its transformed values are 0.0.

splits.strategy: stratified by class label into 60% train, 20% dev and 20% test
splits.seed_policy: Each seed independently re-splits all samples. Selection uses only the dev split, and the held-out test split is scored after selection.

hyperparameters.method: full-batch gradient descent on the mean binary cross-entropy
hyperparameters.convergence_policy: Each step computes the full-batch gradient. The run stops when max|gradient| < tolerance or after max_steps, whichever comes first. A non-finite loss or update stops the run, marks it diverged and excludes it from model selection.

selection.criterion: Highest development positive-class F1 across learning rates and thresholds among runs that did not diverge.
selection.tie_break: smallest threshold, then smallest learning rate
selection.held_out: Each model evaluates the test split once per seed after selection.

metrics.accuracy: fraction of correctly labelled held-out samples
metrics.positive_precision: precision for malignant cases, positive class 1
metrics.positive_recall: recall for malignant cases, positive class 1
metrics.positive_f1: F1 for malignant cases, positive class 1
metrics.roc_auc: threshold-independent AUC over the predicted probabilities
metrics.confusion_matrix: [[true negatives, false positives], [false negatives, true positives]]

baseline.training_data: The same scaled training split and label remap as the NumPy implementation.
baseline.threshold_selection: An independent development positive-class F1 sweep over the same threshold grid.
baseline.role: independent implementation check on identical data

repeats.purpose: report seed-to-seed variation of the selected protocol

protocol.intended_use: This experiment uses a small teaching dataset. Do not use its outputs for diagnosis or treatment.
